analysis_set.span: Efficacy data were analyzed for both the intention-to-treat and the per-protocol populations. The intention-to-treat population included all randomized patients who received at least one dose of the study drug.

follow_up.span: In-hospital mortality was a secondary outcome and adverse events were assessed.

entry_age.span: ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 18 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL

notes: The packet contains no held_local/...html source despite the brief. Analysis-set evidence comes from the same-trial post-hoc report (PMC5472276), which excluded antibiotic-monotherapy recipients; it describes general efficacy analyses in both ITT and per-protocol populations and does not directly establish the analysis set for the original served mortality counts. Its stated ITT definition requires at least one study-drug dose. The served mortality endpoint is in-hospital, not a fixed 30-day assessment. Severe CAP and high inflammatory response restrict the population within the broader question; no entry criterion establishes a population outside that question.
